patch_proposals.original_text: The internal **Crust Chant Action Plan, Market View and Growth Strategy** defines the business as a founder-led sourdough bakery focused on naturally leavened bread, long fermentation, consistent quality and direct customer relationships. The intended first-stage model is production and distribution rather than a café-first or restaurant-first operation. Its current channels are direct retail, subscriptions, selected wholesale, controlled delivery and selected pop-ups.

The intended first-stage model is production and distribution rather than a café-first or restaurant-first operation. Its current channels are direct retail, subscriptions, selected wholesale, controlled delivery and selected pop-ups.

patch_proposals.original_text: A 2023 LINE MAN Wongnai restaurant-industry release reported that breakfast eateries, including sandwich businesses, were among the categories with the highest growth in new restaurants. This is a historical category signal, not current local demand proof. More current local evidence comes from active 2026 menus: several Bangna/Bang Phli cafés currently offer breakfast, sandwiches, sourdough products or brunch for delivery.

patch_proposals.original_text:
## 17. Sources

### Internal source

* **Crust Chant — Action Plan, Market View and Growth Strategy**, discussion draft v3, July 2026. Internal founder-provided source of truth for current strategy, products, channels, equipment and operating principles.

### Market and platform context

* [LINE MAN Wongnai: restaurant-industry release reporting 2023 growth in breakfast eateries/sandwiches](https://lmwn.com/line-man-wongnai-restaurants-2023-en/) — published 24 July 2023; observed 16 July 2026. Used as historical category context, not current local demand proof.
* [Reuters: Delivery Hero to exit Thailand](https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/delivery-hero-exit-thailand-2025-04-23/) — published 23 April 2025; observed 16 July 2026. Reports foodpanda’s Thailand platform closure effective 23 May 2025.
* [Grab Thailand merchant page](https://www.grab.com/th/en/merchant/) — publication date unavailable; observed 16 July 2026. Confirms active merchant onboarding and merchant tools; no public commission assumption was taken from it.

### Bangna / Bang Phli competitors and analogues

* [Horme Cafe Bangna — Wongnai menu](https://www.wongnai.com/restaurants/590757kx-horme-cafe-bangna/menu?menuGroupId=items) — publication date unavailable; status, menu categories and ratings observed 16 July 2026.
* [Horme Cafe official Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/hormecafe.official/) — publication date unavailable; observed 16 July 2026. Used to verify delivery-platform presence and stated opening hours.
* [Routine Coffee ’n More Bangkaew — Wongnai x LINE MAN delivery](https://www.wongnai.com/delivery/businesses/977577Af/order) — publication date unavailable; status and menu observed 16 July 2026.
* [Wongnai Bang Phli bakery/café directory](https://www.wongnai.com/c/24/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9A%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88-%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%84%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%81?areas=955\&categories=24\&sort.type=3) — publication date unavailable; observed 16 July 2026.
